# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Moved the shared conservation fixture helpers out of `tank_core`'s public library surface into `crates/tank_core/tests/support/test_fixtures.rs`, removed the `pub mod test_fixtures` export from `crates/tank_core/src/lib.rs`, and updated both `crates/tank_core/tests/conservation_regression.rs` and `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_conservation.rs` to include that shared test-only module via `#[path = ...]`. This keeps fixture reuse between the unit and e2e suites while excluding the helper code from `tank_core` release builds.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current test-fixture export and the two conservation suites to confirm the only remaining review item was release-build exposure of test-only helpers.
2. [Completed] Moved the shared fixture and trace helpers from `crates/tank_core/src/test_fixtures.rs` into `crates/tank_core/tests/support/test_fixtures.rs`, removed the library export, and rewired both conservation suites to import the shared test-only module by path.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting plus targeted regression and release-build validation to verify the shared fixtures still work for both suites and are no longer part of the `tank_core` release build.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test conservation_regression -- --nocapture` passed: 6 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_conservation -- --nocapture` passed: 1 test passed, 0 failed; the summary still reported all 6 scenarios as PASS with the expected deltas, including `water_change` at `dN=+21.187500000 mg` and `dC=+97.500000000 mg`.
- `cargo check -p tank_core --release` passed, confirming `tank_core` still builds in release mode after removing the public test-fixture module from the library surface.

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
